selectedEdition.title: The 12 Week Year: Get More Done in 12 Weeks than Others Do in 12 Months
selectedEdition.editionFamilyNote: Locked to the 2013 unabridged English Wiley trade family; later reprints appear structurally equivalent at chapter level.

whyAutoLocked: Google Books and O'Reilly match on the 2013 Wiley English edition family and the full title and subtitle.
The O'Reilly authorized preview preserves the complete chapter map and opening preview text needed for strict early-chapter work.
No translation, abridgment, or revised-edition split surfaced that would materially change chapter order, chapter count, or chapter-level interpretation.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Authorized preview coverage is partial, so chapter prose must stay paraphrase-first and narrower wherever support is limited to headings, subheads, and short preview passages.
